Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000764" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API gates the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000754": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000731" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-23, page Lena for anything Boreal-related this cycle, not Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000722" [decision]: The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000716" [decision]: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000712": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000674": On 2025-09-03 the Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000661" [decision]: On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000600": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman (Tomasz left the Atlas team on 2025-07-30 to join the Dune team).  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000588" [constraint]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas pager; page Priya Raman for anything Atlas-related, not Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000442" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000384": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000368": As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000352" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000343": The product catalog keeps image metadata in a separate table because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000155": The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
Existing entity names: billing API, feature-flags, ledger service, reporting service, the bus, Boreal team, Lena, Marcus, Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler, auth gateway, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, indexer, webhooks, authentication gateway, OpenSearch 2.11, product catalog

The note:

[2025-10-07] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Incident review INC-2025-023. The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03. Root cause: a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
